results.content:
Beat Watcher helps you stay aware of your heart rate on Apple Watch with customizable high and low BPM threshold alerts. Beat Watcher integrates with the Health app to read your heart rate. Use Beat Watcher for: - listening to your body during daily routines - stress awareness and breathing exercises - meditation and mindfulness - workouts and pacing - sleep or rest check-ins - staying aware of high or low heart rate readings Some users with POTS or ME/CFS use Beat Watcher as part of their own pacing and body-awareness routines. Beat Watcher is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, prevent, or manage any condition. Turn the Digital Crown on Apple Watch to set the desired BPM threshold.
